verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs describe background automation: continuous monitoring, alerts and automated evidence collection, plus AI risk auto-scoring. Users can build ingestion workflows with a natural-language AI Editor and have them fire automatically when incoming webhook payloads arrive. However, the evidence consists of one-line feature claims, and the user-configurable automation surface appears limited to ingestion workflows and preset auto-scoring rather than general-purpose autonomous automations. Missing for 10: documented scheduling or general trigger-action automation builder, detail on how user-defined workflows run unattended end-to-end, autonomous agent execution within the platform, independent or hands-on corroboration.
